notes: Task response schemas (e.g., get-products-response.json) define ONLY the body fields; protocol-layer fields live on this envelope.

- MCP: envelope fields and task-body fields are siblings at the root of the tool response. The `payload` object is NOT serialized as a nested key — its body fields are flattened to the root alongside `status`, `context_id`, `context`, etc. This matches MCP's native `structuredContent` convention and is what shipping SDKs (@adcp/client) emit. Conformant MCP receivers parse from the flat root; receivers that expect a nested `payload` key MUST migrate.

- A2A 1.0 with the AdCP profile extension: `task.status.state` carries the transport invocation lifecycle used to select the extraction location; `task.contextId` carries `context_id`, while `task.id` is an independent A2A transport identifier. The complete AdCP response, including its protocol-level `status` and any application-layer `task_id`, is canonically carried in `task.artifacts[0].parts[].DataPart` on final states; `task.status.message.parts[].DataPart` is the fallback container used only for interim A2A states (working, native submitted, input-required) where no final artifact has been emitted yet. For a structured AdCP business rejection or Submitted response, A2A is `completed` while the DataPart carries `status: rejected` or `status: submitted` because the handler invocation succeeded. An AdCP `task_id` MUST NOT be copied into artifact metadata or inferred from `task.id`. Receivers MUST prefer artifacts when present and MUST NOT overwrite a DataPart's status with the A2A state. See `a2a-profile-extension.mdx` and `a2a-response-extraction.mdx` for the full binding and extraction algorithm.

- REST: envelope fields MAY ride on HTTP headers (e.g., `X-AdCP-Status`, `X-AdCP-Context-Id`) or as JSON body siblings; body fields appear at the JSON body root. Implementers choosing the header path SHOULD also mirror to body siblings for non-streaming callers.

Across all three: envelope and body fields are conceptually a single response object. A task response schema MAY declare body fields with the same name as envelope fields (e.g., `errors[]` body-level for per-record validation results vs envelope-level for fatal task failure) and the two MUST be treated as distinct fields by name within their respective namespaces — see `error-handling.mdx#envelope-vs-payload-errors-the-two-layer-model`.

`status` is REQUIRED on the conceptual AdCP response across all transports. On MCP and REST it appears as a sibling field at the JSON root (or `structuredContent` root for MCP). On A2A it is carried inside the authoritative DataPart alongside the task body; `task.status.state` separately carries the A2A transport lifecycle and selects where that DataPart is found. Receivers MUST preserve the DataPart status when present. The schema-level `required: [status]` enforces the post-extraction AdCP shape. `payload` remains intentionally NOT required — it is a documentary grouping construct, never a required wire field. See `mcp-guide.mdx` and `a2a-guide.mdx` for the wire-level patterns receivers MUST implement.
Receivers MUST handle absence of an envelope field (e.g., `replayed` omitted) as the field's documented default — see each field's `default` clause.

verifier_constraints.resolved_purchase_terms: Each purchase carries resolved start_time and end_time. Applicable measurement_terms and performance_standards are copied from the published offer or negotiated successor; omission means no such terms apply.

verifier_constraints.direct_purchase_terms: On buy_products, supplied start_time, end_time, measurement_terms, and performance_standards MUST exactly match the selected published offer; omission inherits that offer.
verifier_constraints.accepted_snapshot_terms: Inside canonical-proposal.commercial_terms, each purchase MUST carry resolved start_time and end_time and MUST preserve every applicable measurement term and performance standard. Omission of measurement_terms or performance_standards means the accepted offer declared none.

x-adcp-validation.description: JSON Schema draft-07 cannot compare values across sibling arrays. Conformance tooling MUST reject any place identity present in both geo_places and geo_places_exclude. Catalog version is deliberately not part of place identity: a stable ID cannot be both included and excluded by assigning different versions.
Every value_labels key MUST also appear in values. JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express this sibling-field key membership constraint, so conformance tooling must enforce it.

`dimensions[]` is an array for readable intersection syntax, but `kind` is a logical set key. JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express unique-by-property for this array shape, so conformance tooling should reject repeated `kind` values.

external:enums/media-buy-valid-action.js.x-deprecated-enum-values-doc: Coarse legacy values retained for backwards compatibility with 3.x sellers. Each rolls up to one or more finer-grained values published in 3.1 (see `enumMetadata[<value>].rollup`). Removed in 4.0.

enumMetadata.$comment: Structured per-action metadata. Each entry carries `update_fields` (the `update_media_buy` request fields this action covers, as dotted paths rooted at the request body) and optional `rollup` for legacy coarse values that are superseded by finer-grained vocabulary. SDKs MUST consume this block to dispatch update_media_buy requests rather than parsing the field-mapping table in the update_media_buy task-reference doc; the doc is the human-readable mirror of this normative data. Deprecated values are marked at the top-level `x-deprecated-enum-values` (repo convention); SDKs and codegen MAY hide deprecated values from caller-facing surfaces when any value in the entry's `rollup` array is present in the same `available_actions[]` or `valid_actions[]` payload.

verifier_constraints.ctv_experience_matrix: ctv_ad_experience on image must be pause or screensaver
verifier_constraints.motion_level_static_canonical: motion_level full_motion is rejected on image
verifier_constraints.ctv_activation_copy_slots: push_notification activation_methods SHOULD declare an activation_message slot; text_message SHOULD declare an activation_text_message slot; email SHOULD declare activation_email_subject and activation_email_body slots. Missing copy slots emit a non-blocking validate_input warnings[] entry.

external:formats/canonical/_base.json.x-canonical-policy-required-params-not-e: Canonical format schemas intentionally do NOT mark any of their parameter fields as `required` and use `additionalProperties: true`. The canonical is the loose contract — describing what parameters MAY narrow it. Products narrow the canonical with concrete values (and may also leave most parameters absent — buyers infer behavior from the canonical's prose description for any unspecified parameter). This is intentional, not an oversight: enforcing required params on the canonical would force every product to declare every parameter, which is the wrong direction (we want products to declare only the values that differ from sensible canonical defaults). Adopters writing strict validators should validate against the canonical's structural shape (what fields ARE valid) and apply business rules separately for product-level narrowing minima.

verifier_constraints.ctv_experience_matrix: ctv_ad_experience on video_hosted must be screensaver
ctv_ad_experience on video_vast must be one of pause, screensaver, overlay, squeezeback, in_scene, with creative_type nonlinear
verifier_constraints.ctv_nonlinear_no_simid: Every video_vast CTV experience is nonlinear and forbids simid_supported true because VAST serializes InteractiveCreativeFile only under Linear MediaFiles
verifier_constraints.ctv_duration_floors: overlay and squeezeback require duration_ms_exact or duration_ms_range minimum of at least 10000; in_scene at least 3000; pause has no floor
verifier_constraints.ctv_activation_copy_slots: push_notification activation_methods SHOULD declare an activation_message slot; text_message SHOULD declare an activation_text_message slot; email SHOULD declare activation_email_subject and activation_email_body slots. Missing copy slots emit a non-blocking validate_input warnings[] entry.
verifier_constraints.creative_type_precedence: creative_type wins over linear_required when both are declared; linear_required true with creative_type nonlinear or either is a contradiction and is rejected

verifier_constraints.ctv_experience_matrix: ctv_ad_experience on sponsored_placement must be menu, squeezeback, or in_scene
ctv_ad_experience on native_in_feed must be menu or overlay
verifier_constraints.menu_profile_fields: menu_placement and focus_behavior require ctv_ad_experience menu
verifier_constraints.focus_video_pairing: focus_behavior autoplay_muted or autoplay_sound requires the effective slots to include the video asset group
verifier_constraints.ctv_activation_copy_slots: push_notification activation_methods SHOULD declare an activation_message slot; text_message SHOULD declare an activation_text_message slot; email SHOULD declare activation_email_subject and activation_email_body slots. Missing copy slots emit a non-blocking validate_input warnings[] entry.

verifier_constraints.initial_state_resolution: initial_state_id must resolve to a declared state
verifier_constraints.single_state_shape: when states has one entry, transitions must be absent or empty and initial_state_id must equal the sole state; when states has more than one entry, transitions must be present and non-empty
verifier_constraints.transition_exit_determinism: at most one transition out of a given state per cause tuple (trigger, plus input for user_action, media_event for media_event, direction for scroll_threshold); distinct causes may coexist and the seller runtime arms whichever inputs the device supports
verifier_constraints.transition_state_resolution: transition endpoints must resolve to distinct declared states
verifier_constraints.scroll_progress_bounds: scroll_start_percent must be less than scroll_end_percent
verifier_constraints.scroll_linked_binding: transition_mode scroll_linked is valid only with trigger scroll_progress
verifier_constraints.state_reachability: every non-initial state must be reachable from initial_state_id
verifier_constraints.timer_cycle_floor: timer and in_view_timer transitions participating in a state cycle must declare delay_ms >= 1000
verifier_constraints.dismissibility_floor: any state anchored overlay or fullscreen_overlay requires user_controls.dismissible true or that state's close_affordance true
verifier_constraints.breakpoint_id_uniqueness: breakpoints[].breakpoint_id values must be unique within each state
verifier_constraints.width_range_order: width_range minimum must be less than or equal to maximum
verifier_constraints.height_range_order: height_range minimum must be less than or equal to maximum
verifier_constraints.aspect_consistency: canvas_aspect_ratio must be consistent with fixed width and height when both are declared
verifier_constraints.duration_ms_range_order: duration_ms_range[0] must be less than or equal to duration_ms_range[1] when both are non-null
verifier_constraints.motion_animation_bound: max_animation_s is required when a state's motion is animated and forbidden when static
verifier_constraints.slot_binding_resolution: states[].slot_bindings values must resolve to declared slot asset_group_ids
verifier_constraints.allowed_slot_asset_types: declaration slots (including params.slots overrides) must not widen the canonical's allowed asset types; executable types are rejected
verifier_constraints.supply_mode_manifest: components mode forbids state_canvases and layered_source assets; rendered_canvases mode requires full canvas coverage and forbids layered_source; layered_source mode requires a layered_source asset and forbids state_canvases
verifier_constraints.fluid_breakpoint_supply: breakpoints using width_mode or viewport_height_percent cannot be targeted by rendered_canvases supply
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_coverage: in rendered_canvases mode, exactly one state_canvases image per declared state and breakpoint pair
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_dimensions: canvas width must equal declared width or fall within width_range; height must equal fixed height or fall within height_range
verifier_constraints.state_canvas_extras: undeclared and duplicate state/breakpoint pairs are rejected
verifier_constraints.clickthrough_policy: landing_page_url required when clickthrough is required; landing_page_url and state_click_urls forbidden when clickthrough is none
verifier_constraints.state_click_url_resolution: state_click_urls entries must carry state_id resolving to a declared state, with at most one entry per state
verifier_constraints.lean_policy_warnings: non-user-action transitions into overlay/fullscreen_overlay anchoring, hover-triggered expansion, and scroll transitions into overlay anchoring emit policy warnings (non-blocking)

verifier_constraints.selector_resolution: state_id and breakpoint_id resolve against the containing seller_rendered_stateful_display declaration; coordinated_placements component constraints omit both selectors
verifier_constraints.region_bounds: percent regions satisfy x + width <= 100 and y + height <= 100; pixel regions fit within every selected canvas

verifier_constraints.required_component: at least one component must be required
verifier_constraints.placement_ref_resolution: components[].placement_ref values must resolve to distinct Product.placements[] entries
verifier_constraints.format_option_ref_resolution: component references resolve only against sibling format_options entries on the same product
verifier_constraints.component_kind: resolved and inline components cannot be custom or coordinated_placements
verifier_constraints.inline_params: inline params validate against the schema selected by inline format_kind
verifier_constraints.component_assets: required components have a component_assets entry satisfying their resolved canonical slots
verifier_constraints.sequence_values: when any component declares sequence, sequence values must start at 1 and be contiguous across the declared set
verifier_constraints.referenced_option_schema: declarations resolved via format_option_ref are schema-validated identically to inline params
verifier_constraints.shared_slot_consumers: every shared_slots[].consumed_by value resolves to a declared component_id whose canonical slots accept the shared asset_group_id and asset_type
